sentence: These have not previously been recorded in South Sudan but had been sold to dealers in Khartoum well into 2023.115 The Panel has identified several weapons of this type,116 including the exact combination of a BRG 55 rifle and scope, in the possession of RSF soldiers in 2024.

Individuals with military or political connections have, however, continued the cross -border trade.118 While people, arms, ammunition and looted goods, such as cars, have entered South Sudan from the Sudan, fuel, food and other commodities have travelled the other way.
